terra.problem: The verse says his blood will be on his own head if the sword comes and takes him away, not simply if he ignores the warning.
The verse also requires that the sword come and take away a life before the watchman is held accountable for that blood.
The line omits the condition that the man walks in the statutes of life without practicing iniquity, making the stated actions alone sufficient.
